description:
Consolidates 6 deferred benchmark implementations from
implement-dataframe-benchmarks (completed 2026-02-18) and 3 DataFusion-specific
gaps from fix-read-primitives-datafusion-df (completed 2026-02-12).

These benchmarks were descoped because they don't map cleanly to the DataFrame
read-query model. Each needs dedicated architecture work before implementation.

DataFrame benchmark deferrals:
- TPC-DI (38 ops): ETL pipeline with mutation-heavy SCD Type 2 operations
- Write Primitives (109 ops): INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL - needs write-operation adapter layer
- TPC-DS-OBT (89 queries): Fully denormalized table doesn't map to TPC-DS DataFrame schema
- TPC-Havoc (220 queries): Tests SQL optimizer syntax rewriting - meaningless for DataFrames
- JoinOrder (113 queries): Tests SQL optimizer join ordering - DataFrames handle joins programmatically
- Read Primitives (136 queries): Catalog-driven architecture with DB-specific features

DataFusion v50 gaps:
- string_to_array returning actual list expressions (not split_part proxy)
- array_sum / list.sum() (no built-in; needs unnest+aggregate workaround)
- array_distinct Arrow type normalization (returns Dictionary instead of Utf8)

deferrals.reason: These benchmarks test SQL optimizer behavior (syntax rewriting, join ordering) which is meaningless for DataFrame execution. Likely never applicable to DataFrame mode.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] obsolete: Reason states DataFrame execution bypasses SQL parsing entirely, so this is 'likely never applicable'; self-obsoleting.
